verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is an app catalog listing that shows '4 triggers' alongside actions, so event-source components exist in Pipedream's app catalog. Nothing shows how an agent subscribes to those triggers or receives their events through the MCP server instead of polling, and the MCP docs describe only tool calls. Missing for 10: documented trigger/webhook subscription via MCP, event delivery mechanism to the agent, deployment/configuration docs for triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
